data.long_meaning: From the Old German word 'geriz,' meaning 'spear.' The name 'Gert' was derived from this word and was used to denote a spear bearer or warrior. In the Middle Ages, it was also used as a pet form of Gerhard or Gerhardus, which means 'brave with a spear.'. The name Gert carries the meaning “Spear bearer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gert usually hope their child will grow to embody spear bearer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
